newsitem.title: CHINA: Poison gas kills 10 in China coal mine tragedy.
newsitem.headline: Poison gas kills 10 in China coal mine tragedy.

text.p: Poisonous fumes killed 10 miners in a coal mine near Beijing, a Chinese newspaper reported on Saturday.
The incident occurred on Thursday when two workers inspecting a mine in Shijiaying township were poisoned by a cloud of deadly gas, the Beijing Daily said.
Eight other miners were killed when they rushed into the mine to help their colleagues, it said.
The newspaper gave no further details.

About 10,000 people die each year in accidents in China's mines, which include tens of thousands of small-scale coal mines that operate with little or no safety measures and are staffed by poorly trained workers.
